transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
For the last couple of years I just can’t think clearly or make up my mind about anything, even simple stuff. It's been really frustrating, and I just don't know what to do about it anymore.
Along with these difficulties in thinking, have you also been feeling consistently down, sad, or low in spirits for most of the past two years?

Yes, I have. It feels like this steady, heavy gray cloud is always sitting on my chest, whether I'm at work or at home. It's been like this for a little over two years now, pretty much since I graduated high school and started working at the clinic.
Besides feeling down, do you also find yourself constantly worrying or feeling anxious about many different everyday things, to the point where it is hard to control?
No, I wouldn't really say I feel anxious or constantly worried in that way. It's more that I just feel completely empty, exhausted, and unable to make even simple decisions.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This heavy feeling and the lack of clarity have been pretty much constant and steady the entire two years since I graduated high school. It's just been one continuous drag without any real relief.
How have your sleep patterns and appetite been during these past two years?
No matter how much sleep I get, I always wake up feeling completely wiped out and tired. As for my appetite, I haven't really noticed any major changes or paid much attention to it.
During these past two years, have you also struggled with feelings of hopelessness about the future or felt like you have low self-esteem?

Yes, I feel really hopeless about the future. I just see myself stuck in this same job and town while all my friends move on, and it feels like nothing I do, even taking night classes, is going to change that. Comparing myself to them makes me feel completely left behind and like I've already limited my future.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt the exact opposite of down—like you were filled with intense energy, needed very little sleep, or felt on top of the world?
No, I’ve never experienced anything like that at all. My mood has just been consistently low and heavy, and I’ve never had those bursts of high energy or felt on top of the world.
To help me rule out other causes, do you have any medical conditions, like thyroid issues, or do you use any medications, alcohol, or drugs?
No, I don't have any medical conditions like thyroid issues that I know of. I also don't take any medications, and I don't drink alcohol or use any recreational drugs.
